facts: 5299 reads four DS record bytes at BX with +10 stride, first sign selects DS3340/42, masks each index7F/wordCBW/twoSHL, reads strided DS347F+4*index and always NEGs AL: JL sees preceding SHL SF=OF=0, MOVs do not redefine FLAGS. Unsigned max DL is then byte-absolute-valued, wordlookup DS32EE+2*DL supplies AL for byte MUL DL with DX=DI. POPBX restores saved AX containing first record byte, not original BX; CF is MUL upper-byte-nonzero.

5022 and5446 use raw ring origins/endwords, -8 stride and low SUB/high SBB; 5022 clobbers BP as a wrapping update count, 5446 loads BP/DI from fields and walks two separate record bases. No sortedness/alignment/count or bounded termination assumed.

4F92 and5B5A use explicit3E DS overrides on BP+SI records, not defaultSS. Signed branch direction differs between first/subsequent and forward/backward comparisons. All low-word borrows and signed overflow are retained; modulo correction and ring-end tests read source-order memory.

All five entries use nearRET consuming2. Only5299 saves AX/popsBX;4F92 updating path saves/restores SI from real SS. Other BP/DI/SI clobbers are raw register contracts. Native budgets stop before documented loop sites with existing prefix state and SS writes.

Fifteen direct sites in five owner bodies recorded; caller windows are source observations, not full FLAGS/DS/SS/writer/lifetime/core closure. Initialized table views may overlap state and DAT-fed storage; original values, units and complete formats unassigned.
limits: Instruction/segment/near-return and 256 shift-predicate checks only; separate from native vectors.
